newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal's BCP says Mundial not strategic.
newsitem.headline: Portugal's BCP says Mundial not strategic.

text.p: Banco Comercial Portugues does not regard its 20 percent holding in the Champalimaud group's Mundial Confianca as strategic, chairman Jorge Jardim Goncalves said on Wednesday.
"It was not a strategic position. It was not a desired position," Goncalves told a news conference to present his group's first quarter results.
Nevertheless, it was a "stable" holding, he said, without giving more details.
There has been press speculation that the stake in the insurance company, which acts as the main holding for the Champalimaud group's financial activities, could be sold.
Deutsche Bank de Investimento (DBI), the Portuguese unit of Germany's Deutsche Bank AG, on Monday denied a weekend newspaper report that it could be a buyer.
